messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tell your doctor and pharmacist about all the medicines you take, including prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal products.
Medicines that need particular care:
Lithium.
Lithium and diuretics generally should not be taken together.
Hydrochlorothiazide reduces how quickly the kidneys clear lithium.
This reduction carries a high risk of lithium toxicity.
Cholestyramine and colestipol.
These cholesterol-lowering resins bind hydrochlorothiazide in the gut.
They can reduce how much you absorb by up to 85 percent for cholestyramine and 43 percent for colestipol.
The doses need to be separated.
The label advises taking hydrochlorothiazide for the oral suspension.
The label advises taking hydrochlorothiazide at least 4 hours before the resin.
The label advises taking hydrochlorothiazide 4 to 6 hours after the resin.
NSAIDs such as ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin), naproxen (Aleve), diclofenac, meloxicam, indomethacin, celecoxib and aspirin.
NSAIDs can reduce the fluid-clearing and blood-pressure-lowering effects of hydrochlorothiazide.
Triplet: ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "reduced absorption by", "colestipol"]

The relation 'reduced absorption by' in the triplet is defined as 'The absorption of the subject drug is decreased due to the presence of the substance specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'reduces': The subject drug decreases or lessens the condition or effect specified by the object entity.
B. 'lowers level of': The subject drug decreases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
C. 'has dose limitation': The subject drug has a restriction on the dose specified by the object entity.
D. 'passes into': The subject drug is transferred into the substance or bodily fluid specified by the object entity.
E. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
